title.text:
T11: when is Bitcoin volatile? The clock matters, and file time is the wrong clock
Mean absolute 1-minute log return per clock bin, as a multiple of the series' own average (bands: 1.96 standard errors across days). Cut file (Bitstamp) with file time converted to UTC by timefix.py, seam bars excluded (2.53 M bars before 2021-11, 1.94 M
bars after); Binance forward file in UTC (0.53 M bars). Weekend = Saturday / Sunday UTC. The bottom-middle panel shows the same data under the two clocks: in file time the US-session peak sits 4-5 hours late and is smeared by the daylight-saving switch.
